enrichment.headline: Sets the Career Technical Education Advisory Committee at 13 members and names them
enrichment.summary: The board is adopting a resolution that sets the number of members of the Career Technical Education Advisory Committee at thirteen and names the members and their terms. The item's title says the restructure applies retroactively to July 1, 2025. No money is involved.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Career Technical Education Advisory Committee – Restructure – Retroactive To July 1, 2025

enrichment.headline: Adds $17,545 to Terraphase's traffic study for the Garfield Elementary modernization project
enrichment.summary: Terraphase Engineering is doing a traffic and circulation analysis to address transportation issues found in the project's environmental (California Environmental Quality Act) checklist. This amendment adds $17,545.00, which includes a $1,595.00 contingency fee, raising the contract limit from $81,381.00 to $98,926.00. It also extends the end date from December 31, 2025 to June 30, 2026, an additional 181 days.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement – Terraphase Engineering Inc. – Garfield Elementary School Modernization Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Moka Engineering $5,888 to move a shed at Stonehurst Elementary for the solar project
enrichment.summary: Moka Engineering Construction, LLC will move the existing shed in the school yard at Stonehurst Elementary School about 30 linear feet. The work is part of the district's Photovoltaics (solar panel) Phase 2 and 3 project and is paid as a lump sum. Work began August 20, 2025, before this approval, and was to end by September 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
